Q1: The root-cause fix lives in `.github/actions/claude-pool-token/`, which this heal issue's scope does not include. How should this issue proceed?
Choices:
A. Stay inside the frozen scope and fix only `plan.yml`. Add a step just before "Resolve Claude credential" that writes `{"type":"commonjs"}` to `.codex-workflow-src/.github/actions/claude-pool-token/package.json`. Add a regression test under `tests/` that runs the action's `main.js`/`post.js` below an ESM parent `package.json` with that file in place, plus a changelog fragment. This unblocks planning for `digital_pa#145`. The other 15 workflows that use the action (clarify, implement, review, poller judges, etc.) stay broken in ESM consumers until a separate root-cause issue lands. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Root-cause fix only. Add `.github/actions/claude-pool-token/package.json` (`{"type":"commonjs"}`) and optionally a `try/catch` in `main.js`, plus the regression test. This fixes every workflow at once, but it touches a path outside the heal scope. A trusted person must close this issue and file a replacement issue whose `files_touched:` lists `.github/actions/claude-pool-token/package.json`, `.github/actions/claude-pool-token/main.js`, `tests/**` and `changelog.d/*`. Run as it stands, this issue would be refused at implement time.
C. Do A in this issue now, and also file a separate root-cause issue as described in B. Once that lands, a later change removes the `plan.yml` workaround.
